### Instrument Details & Topology

- **Curved Guide / Bender:** 10 sequential curved `Guide_gravity` sections ($m_{\text{right}}=3$, $m_{\text{left,top,bottom}}=1$, 9 slits each)
- **Straight Guide:** 4 sequential straight `Guide_gravity` sections ($m=1$)
- **Collimation & Apertures:** Slits `aperture1` ($A1w \times A1h$), `s6_slit` ($R = S6$), and `APERTURE2` ($R = A2$ at distance $L1$)
- **Monitors:** Integrated position-sensitive (PSD) and wavelength (L) monitors along the beamline with `restore_neutron=1`.
